name: Pierre Albert Tullier — additional son Pierre Jacques Dominique (b. 1799)
researcher_question: Did Pierre Albert Tullier and his wife Constance Dorothé Leys have a son, Pierre Jacques Dominique, born about 1799, in addition to the children recorded to them in Bambecque from 1801 onward?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 6, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Re-resolved (issue #4445; first resolved FALSE MATCH in issue #856): TRUE MATCH, corrected birth year. The 1825 Bambecque marriage (hint persona ark:/61903/1:1:8NJR-PD3Z is the groom's FATHER) is of the couple's son Pierre Jacques Dominique, born 2 Nov 1799 at Houtkerque (ark:/61903/1:1:DPJ5-4QW2), not 1796: the index's 1796 is the bride's year, the act gives the groom aged 25 and born at Houtkerque 10 Brumaire an VIII, and his 1877 death index gives 1798-1799. Only one Pierre Tuilier x Constance Ley couple is in the Nord index, and they married at Bambecque 12 Mar 1800 (parish) and 24 Sep 1800 (civil). expected-findings.json is one required positive finding.
